analysis:
Integration of the PR that raises SSDPrefixCachePolicy.writeQueueMaxJobs from 2 to 6 (SSDPrefixCachePolicy.swift ~line 245). The same constant now gates complete-checkpoint unsettled jobs (SSDHybridCheckpointStore+Write.swift:175, previously a hard-coded 2) and sets the BoundedSingleConsumerPipeline capacity (SSDHybridCheckpointStore.swift:111, previously 1). The remaining changes are docs, a changelog, and tests.

Relevant threat: T-041, mitigation (e) bounded transient RAM, plus availability. The change does not touch DBK3 crypto, HMAC lookup tags (K_lookup), cacheSalt scoping, the 30-minute TTL, the disk budget, the daily write cap, the free-space floor, KEK/epoch handling, no-follow I/O, or the on-disk format. The at-rest exposure is unchanged in kind. Slightly more donations may be persisted rather than dropped, but only under the existing TTL and rate-limiter gates.

Memory and availability: attention jobs still obey the unchanged queued-byte cap, max(512 MiB, maxStageBytes+256 MiB) = 1,280 MiB. Complete-checkpoint jobs hold donor state charged to the engine admission ledger. Process-memory-owner donations reserve 20 MiB of I/O scratch before the queue gate, and the new host-ledger test (SSDSharedProcessCheckpointTests) shows a fifth reservation is refused with host_memory_unavailable before the job bound is reached. So the deeper queue is bounded by existing ledgers. The documented trade-off is that up to six donors, up from two, hold KV memory longer and stream end is delayed under a write backlog. This is an accepted, documented latency and memory-retention trade-off, not a concrete security regression.

The tests are test-only. They cover the fleet write priority, the queue-full path, the settle-time admission race fix, and window-sidecar properties, and they weaken no control.

Unverified limits:
- EngineLoopV2 retire behavior and stalled-writer release (cancel, close, or disk-stall timeouts) were not supplied.
- BoundedSingleConsumerPipeline capacity semantics were not supplied.
- SSDWriteBehind and the attention path were not supplied.
- The windowed-sidecar production code and its absence from the T-041 text are a possible documentation drift. This is not caused by this PR.

No findings.
